wovenEchoes.name: Antipode Rift
wovenEchoes.description: Travel back to the ancient era and destroy whatever created the antipode rift. Always drops a unique piece of armor.

wovenEchoes.name: Besieged Gardens
wovenEchoes.description: Complete the objective to claim loot fit for a great Sentinel.

wovenEchoes.name: Blood of Farwood
wovenEchoes.description: Slay Yrun, Champion of Morditas

wovenEchoes.name: Bountiful Wilds
wovenEchoes.description: Complete the objective to claim loot fit for a great Primalist.

wovenEchoes.name: Cave of Shadows
wovenEchoes.description: Complete the objective to claim loot fit for a great Rogue.

wovenEchoes.name: Cemetery of Reweaving
wovenEchoes.description: A Cemetery of the Erased where woven echoes can be exchanged for others, once the Woven Firstborn has been slain.

wovenEchoes.name: Circle of Frozen Blood
wovenEchoes.description: Go to battle against Morditas, son of Heorot.

wovenEchoes.name: Conquered Tower
wovenEchoes.description: Confront multiple Nemeses to scale the tower.

wovenEchoes.name: Dead Forest
wovenEchoes.description: Complete the objective to claim loot fit for a great Acolyte.

wovenEchoes.name: Defiled Fortress
wovenEchoes.description: Venture into the eastern fortress long since broken and defiled by the Harbingers. Disturb the remains of its defenders to confront the Void Nemesis and destroy it. Completing this echo permanently adds the void nemesis to the pool of nemeses you may encounter and improves the chance for rare and exalted items' affixes to become exalted when empowering a nemesis.

wovenEchoes.name: False Temple
wovenEchoes.description: A temple from a forgotten timeline, filled with shrines.

wovenEchoes.name: Frostfire Caverns
wovenEchoes.description: Complete the objective to claim loot fit for a great Mage.

wovenEchoes.name: Lostwood Folly
wovenEchoes.description: Slay the roaming Fateweavers among the trails and woven halls to scatter The Weaver's followers across the surrounding echoes. Packs of The Weaver's followers in those echoes are more powerful, but drop large amounts of memory amber.

wovenEchoes.name: Nesting Grove
wovenEchoes.description: Protect the Rift Beast Nests to spread Rift Beast encounters to surrounding echoes. Cannot add Rift Beast Encounters to Arena Echoes, Woven Echoes, or Cemeteries of the Erased. Only applies to the first attempt at each echo.

wovenEchoes.name: Pillar of Skulls
wovenEchoes.description: The Pillar of Skulls rises high above the Soulfire Bastion. It is here that the Lich Cremorus used soul embers to resurrect champions of ages past and ages yet to come. Stand atop the pillar and slay all champions that would rise to oppose you.

wovenEchoes.name: Plane of Exile
wovenEchoes.description: Contains many Rune Prisons

wovenEchoes.name: Primeval Cascade
wovenEchoes.description: Discover the Rift within the ancient valley and slay the Rift Beast within.

wovenEchoes.name: Sepulchre of the Lost
wovenEchoes.description: Delve into a vast Tomb of the Erased and defeat the Fateweavers to claim the echo specific rewards of all surrounding echoes.

wovenEchoes.name: Site of Carnage
wovenEchoes.description: Fight waves of Wengari.

wovenEchoes.name: Soul Foundry
wovenEchoes.description: Slay enemies to collect as many soul embers as you can before the time runs out. Then spend soul embers at the Soul Gambler. The first item purchased is always a unique.

wovenEchoes.name: The Forgotten Keep
wovenEchoes.description: Wade through the bloodsoaked halls to confront the Baroness.

wovenEchoes.name: The Grand Brewery
wovenEchoes.description: Brawl with beer in the brewery and emerge victorious to claim the Brewmaster's Buckle.

wovenEchoes.name: The Great Bridge
wovenEchoes.description: Break through the fortifications along the great bridge to gain access to the Forge of Fates where you can shatter your set items to reforge them.

wovenEchoes.name: The Seeker's Summit
wovenEchoes.description: Slay Haruspex Orian, Seeker of the Shards, upon the summit of his warcamp. Always drops a unique melee weapon.

wovenEchoes.name: Tower of the Weaver
wovenEchoes.description: An Altar of the Weaver atop a woven tower

wovenEchoes.name: Woven Beacon
wovenEchoes.description: Charge the Great Beacon in this echo to reveal echoes in a large area around it.

wovenEchoes.name: Bloodline Glade
wovenEchoes.description: Slay a pack of randomly evolved Rift Beasts Champions to retrieve the Primordial Exalted Items they guard, each of which has a Primordial Champion Affix.

wovenEchoes.name: Cenotaph of Worlds
wovenEchoes.description: Descend into a labyrinthine Tomb of the Erased and defeat the Ascendant Firstborn to weave new Tombs of the Erased into all surrounding echoes.

wovenEchoes.name: Champions' Colosseum
wovenEchoes.description: A free for all between champions of the arena.

wovenEchoes.name: Collapsing Horizon
wovenEchoes.description: Duel a Harbinger that has already slain the boss of this timeline, and claim its spoils. It drops the same items as it would have had you slain it right after defeating the timeline boss.

wovenEchoes.name: Confluence of Oblivion
wovenEchoes.description: Defeat a Shade of Orobyss of each type to reset this timeline's web of echoes and gain corruption based on the highest corruption reached in any timeline by any character with access to the same stash as this one.

wovenEchoes.name: Farsight Turtle
wovenEchoes.description: Defend the turtle of enormous girth as it transports the Transmuting Gem. Once the attackers are defeated you can harness the gem's power to reweave the fate of your unique items that have legendary potential, either increasing it or decreasing it. The new legendary potential is rolled the same way as the legendary potential of a freshly dropped unique of that type. As such, for most uniques it is mostly likely to change the legendary potential to 0.

wovenEchoes.name: Heart of the Hive
wovenEchoes.description: Destroy the Draal Queen deep beneath the Stonefall Mountains. Always drops a unique ranged or caster weapon.

wovenEchoes.name: Oerden's Watch
wovenEchoes.description: Time travel between the abandoned tower in the Divine Era and the refortified Lich's abode in the Imperial Era. Defeat both the Osprix and Imperial forces to control the Relic of the Oberserver and alter the fate of your items. The Relic allows you to swap between strength, intelligence, dexterity, and attunement affixes on your items.

wovenEchoes.name: Omen's Veil
wovenEchoes.description: Travel to the veil between worlds, where Omens gather. Defeat them to seize control over their influence of the timeline, and attract Omens to surrounding echoes. Shatter their plans completely and you may ascend to the pinnacle of their power.

wovenEchoes.name: Overgrown Graveyard
wovenEchoes.description: Help the denizens of the graveyard repel the invasive plants.

wovenEchoes.name: Pinnacle of Chaos
wovenEchoes.description: Ascend to the pinnacle of the veil. Hold back the Omens' onslaught of champions and shatter their influence over the Monolith.

wovenEchoes.name: Rune Prison Complex
wovenEchoes.description: A runemaster fortress from which Rune Prisons are temporally displaced, and the arcane experiments they created are sealed away. Defeat the wardens to lower the barrier around the Thaumaturgy Device and craft your own experimental items.

wovenEchoes.name: Unclaimed Trove
wovenEchoes.description: Lost caches abound in this graveyard of wrecked vessels.

wovenEchoes.name: Vault of the Barnacle King
wovenEchoes.description: Before he vanished, the Barnacle King stashed his treasure in a hidden vault deep beneath the ground. Search for the lost vault within the caverns and altruistically free the overburdened lizards locked within the caches.

wovenEchoes.name: Woven Vessel of Chaos
wovenEchoes.description: Destroy the Vessel of Chaos in this echo to reroll the rewards of nearby uncompleted echoes.

wovenEchoes.name: Woven Vessel of Memory
wovenEchoes.description: Destroy the Vessel of Memory in this echo to restore nearby completed echoes to their original states, allowing you to complete them again and claim their rewards for a second time. Woven Echoes and echoes containing Vessels of Memory or Vessels of Chaos are unaffected.

wovenEchoes.name: Gauntlet of Strife
wovenEchoes.description: Duel a sequence of empowered bosses and their champions. Once the last enemy has fallen, it will drop two copies of the same random unique item, and you will gain access to the Sacrificial Altar. Here you can sacrifice one copy of a unique item to reroll the properties of another copy of the same unique item.

wovenEchoes.name: Rampant Coast
wovenEchoes.description: Slay a rampantly evolved Rift Beast with a crystallised heart to unlock the ability to evolve your own rift beast Lineages beyond the normal limit.

wovenEchoes.name: The Fading Brink
wovenEchoes.description: Travel to the brink of the black hole, to the end of all timelines that Orobyss has erased. There confront a sequence of Harbingers who have slain the bosses of those timelines and reclaim the treasures they stole.

wovenEchoes.name: Tomb of Vessels
wovenEchoes.description: Confront Majasa among the testaments to her avarice. Quell her rage and claim her riches. Always drops a unique piece of jewelry.

wovenEchoes.name: Demigod's Ascendance
wovenEchoes.description: Go to battle against the God of Bloodshed.

wovenEchoes.name: Fractured Prison
wovenEchoes.description: The Observer's vision of himself begins to coalesce. The Omens must be stopped.

wovenEchoes.name: Threshold of Eternity
wovenEchoes.description: Upon the threshold Aberroth awaits.
